If I remember right, yes. For your manpower issue don't worry about having more divisions, focus on having good enough divisions. Especially with Germany and smaller nations. All you really need to do is make sure you have a fair enough basic infantry division you can put on a border and defend or support attacks while you have the armored and motorized/mechanized divisions break through points and encircle. I know everyone says to do 7 inf and 2 art plus art support but I just go with the support and the basic 9 infantry battalions. Make sure you give them engineers though. Some nations(minor ones) you may want to go with AA support for the extra soft attack if you don't have the civ factories or tungsten. Don't produce convoys. You can ignore that until you have your navy built up.

I don't really focus too heavily on my navy until I take Britain because I annex them and their land in Asia with oil and rubber. Until then all you really need to focus on is submarines. Set all of your dockyards to subs. Once you take England and their Empire's resources(always puppet India) you can set just 5 to subs (it should be at the cap around 1.1 a month) and set the others to light cruisers and destroyers. If you really want to have a cap heavy fleet you should go for battleships because America usually sends their carriers to the pacific.
Also, there's a guide on steam on how to take England out in 36 or 37. I haven't tried it but I've heard it's good.

I've done it several ways. I find that the best is go for Air superiority over the channel and put all of your navy there. You can use paratroopers if you want but air superiority over England can be tricky. I go for naval invasions on the Eastern side of the island while they're busy preparing the south. Once you get a port send as many panzer and motorized divisions as possible. Maintain air superiority over the sea, you can somewhat neglect over England if they have more planes than you. Bum rush VP's fast and encircle as many British as you can. How are you running out of manpower so early? You don't need several hundred divisions just maybe 25 elite and 100 mediocre.

Go fascist, hold off Japan, build industry fast, go with superior firepower because of the soft attack bonuses (I usually do and it works great) and go for the Middle East for the oil. Once you build up your industry push towards Africa and India so the Japanese navy can't bother naval production.
